_doc: The reward the AI learns from. One weight per event; the reward of a decision is the sum of weight x event.
Edit the numbers, keep the names. Events come from the game (src/core/game.ts, Events) once per decision (4 ticks).
Every term is also logged on its own (reward/<name>), so the dashboard shows which part drives learning.
The benchmark never uses this file: it scores with the game's own score (metres + 5 per coin).

meters.doc: per metre moved forward (the game reports mm; we convert). The main signal: survive and go far.

coins.doc: per coin picked up. Off at first: coin greed makes it take risky lanes.

jumps.doc: per jump started. Make it slightly negative if it learns to spam jumps.

rolls.doc: per roll started. Make it slightly negative if it learns to spam rolls.

laneChanges.doc: per lane change. Slightly negative stops left-right jitter.

stumbles.doc: per side hit (the first one only bounces you back; the second within 5 s kills).

died.doc: once, when the run ends in a crash.
